Subject: Redwood demo — initial 60m walkthrough (confirmed)

Hi Logan,

Thanks for locking in the 60-minute walkthrough next Tuesday at 11am PT. We have the product team and two engineering leads confirmed on our side. A quick ask: our security and procurement leads may want to join if we go deeper on data residency and billing terms. I don’t expect the session to change, but I wanted to flag potential +2 attendees.

Attached is our internal list of questions — we included it in case the demo can address any of the items up front.

See you Tuesday,

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — initial 60m walkthrough (confirmed)

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the question list. This is helpful.

Quick internal note: Priya, Vivek — Atlas just flagged that security and procurement leads may join. If both teams are on the call, we should extend to 90 minutes and cover: 1) data flows and VPC options (Vivek), 2) SSO/KMS and audit logs (Priya), and 3) contract/pricing lenses for procurement (Mina). I can lead the product demo but would like Mina on standby for pricing and procurement items.

Is Mina available next Tuesday? If not, would a reschedule to Thursday or the following Monday work? Also, we should circulate a consolidated agenda and the short governance slides.

Thanks,
Logan

redwoodai.com

If security & procurement both join, I agree 90 minutes is safer — suggest we split the agenda into: 1) product demo + integration Q&A (45m), 2) governance/security deep-dive (30m), 3) procurement/pricing + next-steps (15m). I’ll attach a brief governance deck we can share.

Attachments: Governance_Readout_Slides.pptx

Mina
